# Descriptions
@@ 1
Disperses all fog in a 10' per level radius.
@@ 2
Cuts all generalized air movement (e.g., wind) by 30 mph in a 10' radius (will
not affect breathing).
@@ 3
Creates a 5' radius near vacuum; anyone within the radius must make a
successful RR or take a 'B' Impact critical as the air leaves and rushes back
in.
@@ 4
Caster can remove the oxygen in a 10' radius at the rate of 1% of the original
oxygen each round.
@@ 5
As Air Stop I, except affects a radius of 20'.
@@ 6
As Vacuum I, except affects a radius of 10'.
@@ 7
As Deoxygenation I, except affects a radius of 20'.
@@ 8
Changes any gas to normal air at a rate of 1 cubic per round as long as the
caster concentrates.
@@ 9
As Air Stop I, except affects a radius of 100'.
@@ 10
As Vacuum I, except affects a radius of 20'.
@@ 11
As Vacuum I, except delivers a 'D' Impact critical.
@@ 12
As Deoxygenation I, except removal rate is 5% per round.
@@ 13
As Deoxygenation I, except affects a radius of 50'.
@@ 14
As Great Vacuum I, except affects a radius of 10'.
@@ 15
As Mass Deoxygenation I, except affects a radius of 20'.
@@ 17
As any single 10th level or lower spell on this list, except with a range of
300'.
@@ 19
As Deoxygenation I, except affects a radius of 20' and removeal rate is 10%
per round.
@@ 20
As Vacuum I, except delivers an 'E' Impact critical.
@@ 25
As Deoxygenation I, except affects a radius of 20' and removal rate is 20% per
round.
@@ 30
As Major Vacuum, except affects a 10' radius.
@@ 50
Destroys gases in a single enclosure (e.g., usually a building) up to a size
of 100'x100'x100' (or 1,000,000 cu’). The building has a chance of collapsing
(dependent on construction) and everyone inside takes an 'E' Impact critical
from falling debris. This results in a very loud explosion. If the building
collapses, everyone within 100' of the building takes a 'C' Impact critical
from the explosion.
